turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Let us build one sentence: Mia (who), reads (action), a story (thing), at night (time). Together: "Mia reads a story at night."
So the rule is: say who first, then the action, then the thing, then time or place at the end.
Right: Mia reads a story at night. Wrong: Mia at night reads a story.
Now you try. Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
